list.name: cluster
list.label: PG Cluster
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] != ''

list.name: instance
list.label: PG Instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] != ''

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       max(Value) AS backends
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       max(Value) AS hit_ratio
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_cache_hits' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, cluster, instance,
       greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY cluster, instance ORDER BY time
                ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) / 60 AS per_sec
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
             Attributes['namespace'] AS cluster, Attributes['pod'] AS instance, max(Value) AS v
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND Attributes['container'] = 'postgres' AND cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND instance IN (${instance:singlequote})
      GROUP BY time, cluster, instance)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, cluster, instance,
       greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY cluster, instance ORDER BY time
                ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) / 60 AS per_sec
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
             ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance, max(Value) AS v
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND Attributes['datname'] = 'demo' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
      GROUP BY time, cluster, instance)
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       count() / 60 AS per_sec
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000 AS p95_ms
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'])) / 60 AS blks_read_per_sec
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['rows'])) / 60 AS rows_per_sec
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['query_id'] AS query_id,
       substring(any(LogAttributes['db.query.text']), 1, 80) AS query,
       count() AS calls,
       round(100 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 1) AS pct_calls,
       round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1e6, 2) AS total_s,
       round(100 * sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / sum(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us']))) OVER (), 1) AS pct_time,
       round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS avg_ms,
       round(quantile(0.99)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS p99_ms,
       round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'])), 0) AS blks_read
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  AND LogAttributes['query_id'] NOT IN ('', '0')
GROUP BY query_id
ORDER BY total_s DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Client vs PostgreSQL latency by operation

targets.rawSql:
SELECT shape,
       count() AS traces,
       round(avg(a), 3) AS client_ms,
       round(avg(p), 3) AS postgres_ms,
       round(avg(a - p), 3) AS gap_ms,
       round(100 * avg(a - p) / avg(a), 1) AS pct_outside_pg
FROM (
  SELECT app.SpanName AS shape,
         app.TraceId AS tid,
         any(app.Duration) / 1e6 AS a,
         max(pg.Duration) / 1e6 AS p
  FROM (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, SpanName, Duration
          FROM otel.otel_traces
         WHERE ServiceName = 'pgload' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote})) AS app
  INNER JOIN (SELECT TraceId, ParentSpanId, Duration
                FROM otel.otel_traces
               WHERE ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server'
                 AND ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})) AS pg
    ON app.SpanId = pg.ParentSpanId AND app.TraceId = pg.TraceId
  GROUP BY shape, tid)
GROUP BY shape
ORDER BY traces DESC
